statement: ∀ (W : Submodule K (VK K M)) (f : Module.End K (VK K M)), Inv W f → ∀ r : ℕ, Inv W (kdp f r)
proof:
intro W f hf
have hp : ∀ r : ℕ, Inv W (f ^ r) := by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      intro w hw
      simpa only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] using hw
  | succ r ih =>
      intro w hw
      simpa only [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply] using ih (f w) (hf w hw)
intro r w hw
change ((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • (f ^ r) w ∈ W
exact W.smul_mem _ (hp r w hw)
